reply.text:
Fixed. Lint, typecheck, and all 27 tests pass, including the new "when one of two ships fails, only that row goes back" case.

The bug: `onError` restored the whole previous-list snapshot taken at that mutation's `onMutate`. With two ships in flight, if order B's ship landed successfully after order A's snapshot was taken, then order A's failure would roll the cache back to the pre-B snapshot too — silently un-shipping B. Fixed by having each mutation snapshot and restore only its own row's prior status (`onMutate` now records `previousStatus` for that one id; `onError` maps only that id back), so a failing row never touches any other row's state.

It's done.
